scenarios.theme: A frontend times out but downstream work runs for another minute. What changes?
scenarios.assumptions: The user operation has a 500 ms budget. Each of three service hops starts a fresh 500 ms timeout, and cancelled handlers keep spawning queries. What will you do?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

scenarios.theme: An outage turns one RPC into twenty-seven attempts. What is the policy?
scenarios.assumptions: Three layers independently retry three times while the dependency is overloaded. Error rates and queue times worsen. How will you contain the failure?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.
